text:
Maria: Midday async standup — quick notes. did: validated the us-west prewarm script, patched node selector for spot pools, and ran a short soak against the staging queue. blocker: seeing sporadic scaling jitter (queue latency spikes ~300-500ms) when scale-in starts. today: triage logs, open small PR for drain timeout, pause model rollouts in affected regions.
Sam: Can you drop the PR link here? @Maria
Maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/428 — changes: `--drain-timeout=90s`, fallback to on-demand if spot eviction rate > 8% and added log key `node.scale.reason`.
DevOps-bot: CI pipeline passed for canary (build 7921 -> staging) :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Also saw a matching latency blip in eu-west-2 earlier this morning; provider reported transient quota throttling on accelerated compute API. I'll pull quota metrics and eviction rates now. :mag_right:
Lee: Heads up — I'm opening a support case with the cloud provider for eu-west-2 quota bump (case 98765). Support ETA ~48h.
Ana: For today's rollouts — can we hold new model deploys to us-west until prewarm completes? Prefer to avoid cascading evictions. :handshake:
Sam: +1 to holding. Pausing CI triggers for `model-rollout/*` until @Maria confirms it's safe.
Maria: ack, pausing triggers. Quick check command I'm running in ops box:
```
# check prewarm health over last 10 minutes
python scripts/check_prewarm.py --region us-west --lookback 10m
```
Lee: If teams need immediate headroom, we currently have ~6 spare GPUs in ap-northeast-1 that can be temporarily shifted.
Jordan: Can we route low-priority batch traffic to ap-northeast-1? If yes, I'll update routing policy in `routes.yaml` and mark cost tier low.
Sam: Go ahead. Ensure `cost_tier: low` is set so Optimize doesn't reassign for cost savings unexpectedly.
Maria: One more thing — I spotted 3 pods in the prewarm pool reporting `OOMKilled` around 10:12 UTC. I'm opening an issue for pod memory tuning.
Ana: I'll add conservative memory requests/limits and send a PR (10/30) to avoid OOMs during prewarm spikes.
Lee: Ping me when that PR is up, I'll queue a canary and monitor the canary dashboard.
DevOps-bot: Incident recorded: #INC-2026-231 — prewarm OOMs detected.
Sam: Thanks everyone. If no other blockers, wrap up for now. Please post updates here after triage and PRs. :thumbsup:
